amendments.change: Added the output-field projection experiment: an independent development screen advanced before the B2 gate, and a confirmation arm appended after TERMINAL_EVIDENCE.
amendments.reason: Output-field projection is stated as a core principle but no experiment isolates it. The gap was found while auditing which of the project's claims carry measured evidence.
explicitly_unchanged: every existing stage's inputs, ordering and gates
amendments.why_appended_not_inserted: This DAG was preregistered before downstream corpus generation and is already in flight. Inserting a stage would move an existing stage's inputs or ordering; appending after terminal evidence cannot.
amendments.why_dev_screen_is_independent: The development screen consumes no upstream artifact. Queuing it behind the frozen chain would delay development evidence for no scientific reason, and advancing it before the B2 gate keeps every early return from starving it.
amendments.evidence_class_separation: The development screen may inform design and may never be reported as confirmation.

amendments.change: Registered the live decision-routing benchmark track as an independent non-blocking research DAG node.
amendments.reason: #15 requires reproducible live-provider/runtime evidence whose credentials, network availability, model revisions, pricing, accelerator placement and hosted runtime availability are external variables. It should remain visible in the research DAG without becoming a prerequisite for the already-frozen agent-utility chain.
explicitly_unchanged: every existing stage's inputs, ordering and gates
amendments.why_independent: #15 consumes no canonical B2/downstream artifact and can be executed whenever the required external provider/runtime is available. Blocking #432 or #424 on hosted credentials or hardware would mix infrastructure availability with the frozen scientific chain.
amendments.completion_rule: The node is complete only when issue #15 records reproducible live evidence for the required provider paths with dated runtime/model/cost/token/hardware metadata. Local compatibility or deterministic-only runs do not complete the node.

15.label: LIVE_DECISION_EVIDENCE
required_paths: at least one real ModelQueryAnalyzer provider

required_metadata: dated provider pricing and derived cost when applicable

non_completion_examples: wire/API compatibility without a live measurement
a local/open model result without the required hosted/provider paths
